claims.text: Obstructive HCM + acute hypotension ⍉responding to fluids: IV phenylephrine (or another vasoconstrictor w/o inotropic activity), alone or w a BB.
claims.quote: For patients with obstructive HCM and acute hypotension who do not respond to fluid administration, intravenous phenylephrine (or other vasoconstrictors without inotropic activity), alone or in combination with beta-blocking drugs, is recommended.
